adjudication.rationale: In `rest.js.es6`, `basePath(store, type)` now checks `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type.replace('_', '-')) !== -1`. In JS, `String#replace` without a regex only replaces the first underscore, so a model name containing multiple underscores would be only partially normalized (e.g. `foo_bar_baz` -> `foo-bar_baz`) and would not match a fully hyphenated entry in `ADMIN_MODELS`. The current `ADMIN_MODELS` entries added/used in this diff (`site_customization`/`embeddable_host`) only have a single underscore, so this isn’t a demonstrated breakage in the diff, but it is a concrete fragility in the new normalization approach coupled to a hardcoded allowlist.
